howto.what: 插件启用后自动运行:在会话开始和提交提示时注入项目里的静态规则,Codex 修改文件后再按文件匹配注入对应规则,作为附加上下文给出并按会话去重。它不重写工具输出。

howto.what_en: Enabled plugin runs automatically: it injects static project instructions on SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, and matching file-specific rules after Codex apply_patch, as deduplicated extra context. It does not rewrite tool output.
